thread:
Nora: Quick sync  thinking of adding a 'probe-gate' before bench queue: static fingerprint + 2-op microbench + tiny smoke for ambiguous cases. Goal: faster feedback and fewer wasted bench hours. Thoughts?

Diego: Makes sense. For fingerprint use multiset of op-signatures, not op order. Ordering breaks too often with converters.

Sam: Agreed. Microbench should be one matmul + one elementwise; keep tokens <=8 and runs=3 median. If microbench >2x expected -> reject.

Asha: Important: probe outcomes must be ACCEPT / ESCALATE / REJECT. REJECT only for obvious ABI/kernel-missing or catastrophic microbench. Otherwise ESCALATE.

Diego: Add kv-schema-stamp to fingerprint; KV mismatches are frequent.

Sam: UX note: include machine-readable reject reason + single-step reproduce bundle link. Authors can run SDK dry-run locally.

Nora: Rollout: advisory mode for 2 weeks (no automatic blocking), gather probe.vs.bench diffs, tune thresholds.

Asha: Metrics to emit: probe.latency_p95, probe.escalation_rate, probe.reject_reason_counts, bench.regressions_after_probe. Tag by model_family and quant.

compat-bot: Reminder: add compat-ack registry entries (owner contact required) to whitelist known-good families.

Diego: Security: probes must not fetch external URLs. Only inspect uploaded package.

Sam: Microbench recipe: dims 64x128 x 128x64, 3 runs, warmup 1, compare to family baseline. Cap wall-time to 100ms.

Asha: Also auto-create triage issues on REJECT when owner contact exists; include hints like "try converter-x --no-fuse" where applicable.

Nora: Action items: Diego -> fingerprint lib prototype (P0); Sam -> microbench harness + tests (P0); Asha -> rejection taxonomy + UX text (P1); Nora -> RFC update and rollout plan (P0).

Sam: I'll open a small prototype repo after lunch.

Nora: Thanks all, posting RFC patch tomorrow.
